en: Sepia-toned vintage street view showing a cobblestoned avenue lined with multi‑story townhouses and shops. People walk and stand along the street; a cart with bicycles is visible in the foreground. The right side features German shopfront signage on the façades. At the top in red print it reads a location and street name. The overall layout and color tone indicate an old photographic postcard.
